$comment: Sprite sheet manifest. All sheets are horizontal strips, transparent PNG, native pixel resolution (1 texel = 1 art pixel). Set texture scaleMode = NEAREST and integer scale. 8-dir frame order is always [e, se, s, sw, w, nw, n, ne]; sw/w/nw are horizontal mirrors of se/e/ne. Files follow the Art Bible naming convention.

hero_pyromancer_idle_8dir.png.note: player Pyromancer. idle(2)+move(4) x 8 facings, clip sheet. Fire orb hidden on n/ne/nw (back) facings.

mob_skeleton_base.png.note: basic skeleton. idle(2)+move(4) x 8 facings, clip sheet. 'skeleton-lord' = this sheet at higher renderScale; 'burning' = + animated flame overlay (fx, procedural).

mob_ghoul.png.note: skeleton re-skinned to rotting-green (recolor of mob_skeleton_base). Same clip layout, animates identically.

mob_bonecaster_8dir.png.note: ranged skull-mage. Necrotic orb hidden on n/ne/nw.

fx_veilwisp.png.note: radial (no facing); 2-frame bob loop. Floats ~22px above the tile.

icon_skills.png.note: hotbar/inventory icons. Display in a .ts-slot__icon / .ts-item__icon (32×32 at scale 2).

ui_brute_shield.png.note: iron shield overlay for the skeleton brute; draw on the screen-near side.

mob_cinderbat_fly_s.png.note: flying undead trash mob, front (s) facing, 4-frame wing-flap.

boss_cyclops_s.png.note: cyclops boss — one-eyed stone giant, front (s) facing, 2-frame idle breathe.

procedural.$note: These are NOT shipped as PNG — they are drawn in-engine (canvas/Pixi Graphics) so they tint/animate freely. Recipes below.
procedural.loot_beacon: 16×16 diamond gem + vertical light beam + ground ring, all tinted by rarity color (white/blue/yellow/green/gold). Gold adds 3 orbiting fire particles.
procedural.fire_fx: Spark/Fireball/Pyroclasm/Combust/Meteor built from stepped fire-blob discs (white-hot #fff1c4 → ember #ff9f1a → coal #b0301a), blitted nearest-neighbor. Telegraph rings are dashed blob rings.
procedural.burn_flame: 2-frame 5×5 pixel flame (#ff6a2a/#ff8a2a/#ffe9b0) dotted over burning enemies.
procedural.terrain: 64×32 iso diamonds, grass checker #2e3a30/#28342a, rock #2a1a1a, Veil-fissure seam (glowing), ember cracks. Posterized + vignette.
